collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS — GOOD, BAD AND ORDINARY DAYS (DAY-01..50, draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)
Wonderful days, rotten days, mixed days and days when nothing much happens at all. Moods come without reasons, small things matter more than they should, and nobody has to end the day happier, wiser or more productive than they started it.
Written in the style of the owner's own events. Edit anything and send it back; nothing ships until you approve.

ledger.why: the casting line, carried out as the roles' ages (picks an adult)

collection.description: A seagull tries to drag off the biggest fish a villager has caught all season: chase the gull, or let it have the fish.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (name1) has caught the biggest fish (he/she) has caught all season. It took ages. It fought hard. (He/she) has laid it on the rocks for one moment, to rest (his/her) arms, and a seagull has swooped down, grabbed it, failed to lift it, and is now dragging it, very slowly, across the rocks towards the sea.

o2.name: Outcome B
o2.text: (name1) watches the gull struggle. It's working so hard. "Fine," says (name1). "You earned it." The gull gets the fish to the water's edge, where a wave takes it, and the fish, which wasn't quite as dead as everyone thought, swims away. Both (name1) and the gull stare at the sea for a long time.

o1__fx.name: Outcome A
o1__fx.text: (name1) chases the gull. The gull drags the fish faster. (name1) slips on the wet rocks and sits down in a pool. The gull lets go of the fish, looks at (name1) with contempt, and flies off. (name1) gets the fish back. (He/she) is soaked. It's still the biggest fish of the season. It's a mixed sort of day.
